<!--
Patch record of a release. Create the release with:

  gh release create vX.Y.Z --generate-notes --notes-file .github/RELEASE_NOTES_TEMPLATE.md

Then edit the release: fill in the fields below, and add the deploy date once the
release is running in production.
-->

## Patch record

- Release tag: vX.Y.Z
- Deployed to production: YYYY-MM-DD
- Components updated: list them here. A grouped Dependabot pull request shows only its group name under "Dependency updates", so copy the packages from its description.
- CVEs and advisories addressed: none
